verdict: MINIMUM STARTER 0.5% at <=$9.00 GTC — clean-court default. Red's REJECT (7/10) was PARTIALLY OVERTURNED by blue (7/10) and no kill survives the audit: post-audit kills 0 novel fatal / 1 consensus (SBC level, reduced to SIZING). Red's strongest kill — 'the profit inflection is SBC' — was refuted by the issuer's own 8-K reconciliation: ex-SBC margin +409bp vs headline +415bp (Q2 EBITDA-minus-SBC $17.8M vs $7.8M YoY, more than doubled); the causal claim inverted, only the LEVEL critique survives (adj EBITDA overstates cash economics ~$81M/yr). Red's valuation FATAL failed its own arithmetic: red's band tops at $8.13, 12% below tape, before the desk's documented ~13% conservative-FV bias; and on the peer anchor red never pulled, ATEC at 2.26x EV/S is cheapest vs GMED 3.47x (6.9% growth) and SIBN 3.67x (negative EBITDA). The capex-starve/FCF-guide-conflict kill was refuted by the FY24->FY25 natural experiment (capex -49% with case growth held ~20%) and H1'26 (capex +58%, FCF flat). What survives is real and SIZES the position: TTM FCF only +$2.3M, FY26 FCF guide back-half loaded, gross leverage ~4.0x, discovery CROWDED-ish.
